## What landed

- **`ops/src/ops/release_reversal.py`** — the cutover's registry half:
  `compose_floor_generation` writes genesis `conf/0` — empty promoted
  set (every gated namespace 404s, the answer the flat site already
  gives a not-published release route), `withdrawn.conf`/`selectors.conf`
  carried **verbatim** from the floor's own `conf/` fragments (a deny
  map is never re-derived at cutover), `latest.json` a floor pointer
  (`publication_id: None`, `legacy_floor: <label>` — never a pub id),
  and deliberately **no `releases/` index** (the flat site 404s it
  today — writing it would be the one visible change the leg forbids).
  `verb_cutover` refuses a non-`legacy-<YYYYMMDD>` label, an
  unimported/unstaged floor, a registry past genesis (a second
  floor-serve is `rollback --to <label>`'s act), a non-digest
  `--web-image`, and a non-withdrawal-registry `--withdrawals` seed;
  `--apply` requires the authorities go record, writes `conf/0` +
  the `staged/conf/` carry + `registry/serving.json`
  (`sig.serving-layout/1`, `legacy_publish_class: "retired"`, the
  90-day retention record) create-if-absent under the lock, runs six
  post-checks, and journals `legacy-cutover` with the roll intent
  verbatim — or `failed` + a refusal, never a smoothed green.
- **`ops/src/ops/publish.py` + `cli.py`** — the serving-path
  retirement's enforcement half: `publish-web` reads
  `registry/serving.json` (new `--release-registry`, default
  `SIG_RELEASE_REGISTRY`) **before any write or sync**; `--apply`
  refuses once `legacy_publish_class: "retired"`, naming the record.
  No record = legacy path still live; an un-openable registry records
  `_unevaluated` — the guard refuses only a record it read.
- **`ops/gcp/web-cutover.sh`** — the leg-runner, one leg inside
  AR-3 + AR-2: window guard (exit 42 outside weekday 14:00–20:00Z; the
  03:00–06:30Z never band named in the message) → AR-2 prestate
  (service describe, URL-map export, both-origin `route-compare`
  captures, the live tree's rsync snapshot + sha256 manifest) →
  `release import-floor` → `release cutover` → `web.sh --apply image` +
  `run deploy` (`SIG_LATEST_PUB=legacy-…`, `SIG_CONF_GEN=0`,
  min-instances 1, `…-sig-release` at `/mnt/rel` — live mounts read
  back and replaced, never guessed) → `route-compare verify` on the
  canonical origin **and** the run.app URL → recorded rollback text on
  any difference (traffic move to the still-running prior revision).
  Per-leg `--apply` splits a paused run; `SIG_CUTOVER_GO` names the
  authorities record.
- **`docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md` §13** — the procedure + the retirement
  declaration; **`return_pass.toml`** + LEDGER — the `P35.59` leg row,
  with `P34.40-lb-routes`/`P35.53-release-infra` recording P35.59 as a
  `live:` dependant.
